Hi Lydia / Tom —

Thanks for the confirmation and the blackout window. Attached is an updated commitment matrix (HS-Implementation-RACI.pdf) and a proposed kickoff agenda (Kickoff-Agenda-2028-08-09.docx). Summary below — I tried to keep it very actionable.

90-day objective: Establish production-ready inference for Hearthstone search assistant with measurable quality and performance thresholds and a staged cutover that minimizes risk to your traffic.

Key milestones (proposed) — owner (Redwood / Hearthstone):
- Kickoff & access validation — 2028-08-09 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood), Lydia / Tom (Hearthstone)
- Staging integration & test corpus ingestion — complete by 2028-08-23 — Owner: Priyom (Redwood), Hearthstone infra
- Model tuning + eval cycles (2 rounds) — complete by 2028-09-13 — Owner: Priyom (Redwood), Lydia (Hearthstone)
- Pre-cutover performance validation (latency & throughput) — complete by 2028-09-27 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood), Hearthstone infra
- Soft cutover & acceptance window (30 days) — begin 2028-10-01 — Owner: Hearthstone ops with Redwood monitoring support

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Latency P95 ≤ 350ms on production-like traffic during validation windows
- Prompt pass-rate ≥ 88% on the agreed evaluation set (two eval rounds)
- Error rate ≤ 0.5% (5xx, timeouts) during soft cutover

Staging checklist (brief):
- IAM role for Redwood service account + temporary keys for staging (Hearthstone to create)
- Sample payloads (JSON schema) and a 10k-row test corpus
- IP allowlist for Redwood staging endpoint(s)
- Expected baseline throughput (TPS) and target concurrency for tests

Next steps / asks from Hearthstone:
1) Confirm kickoff meeting on Aug 9 at 10:00am PT (we’ll send calendar invite)
2) Share a point of contact for infra to provision staging roles
3) Approve the acceptance criteria or propose changes by Aug 4

Attachments: HS-Implementation-RACI.pdf, Kickoff-Agenda-2028-08-09.docx
